boxes.label: Engine-bay power distribution center (PDC / PDM)
boxes.source: C:/ProgramData/cuore/parts_catalog/stelvio-2018-2.0l/mechanic_electrical.json section electrical--power-distribution-center-fuse-block-junction-block-relays-and-fuses ('There is a rear power distribution center (PDC) as well as engine-bay fusing'; 'fuse 16 (5 A, engine-bay PDM)'); Mopar catalogue catalog.json lists a 'Power Distribution Center Cover' part. Exact position in the engine bay is not stated by any source.

boxes.label: Interior fuse box (passenger-side control unit, footwell)
boxes.source: docs/maintenance/DIGITAL_REAR_VIEW_MIRROR_INSTALL.md, item 'The interior fuse box (passenger side control unit) is in the cabin, passenger side, in the footwell under the glove compartment area' (autouserguide.com search summary; third-party, page itself returned 403, unverified).

boxes.label: Rear power distribution center (rear PDC)
boxes.source: mes-log-mcp/mes/electrical.py element f82, quoting FCA TSB S1808000005 'on GU/Stelvio inspect fuse F82 in the rear PDC'. The TSB gives no panel or cavity; 'rear of car' is the only placement.

boxes.label: Luggage-compartment fuse unit (third-party diagram)
boxes.source: docs/maintenance/DIGITAL_REAR_VIEW_MIRROR_INSTALL.md, item 'The luggage-compartment unit lists F22 20 A ... F21 10 A ... F08 30 A ... F01 40 A' (autogenius, third-party, unverified). It is NOT established whether this is the same box as the rear PDC.

items.label: Fuse F82 (A901 circuit, BCM supply)
items.source: mes-log-mcp/mes/electrical.py element f82 (TSB S1808000005: 'inspect fuse F82 in the rear PDC (A901 circuit)'); cuore mechanic_electrical.json repeats it.
items.notes: Rating not stated by the TSB. A technician forum thread reports F82 blown on a 2018 Stelvio 2.0L (single anecdote, not confirmed as the cause of a no-start). Do not use, borrow from or move this fuse.

items.label: Stand-alone 20 A fuse (BCM power feed)
items.source: mes-log-mcp/mes/electrical.py element bcm_feed_20a (TSB S1808000005: 'Inspect all BCM power feeds including the standalone 20A fuse').
items.notes: The TSB names the rating and role but not which box or position it is in.

items.label: Fuse 16 (5 A) - ignition 1 relay output
items.source: C:/ProgramData/cuore/parts_catalog/stelvio-2018-2.0l/mechanic_electrical.json ('fuse 16 (5 A, engine-bay PDM) is the ignition 1 relay output' - single technician forum thread, diag.net).
items.notes: Single anecdote. The thread reports no-crank/no-ignition traced to this feed and F82. Which modules it feeds is not sourced.

items.label: Starter relay
items.source: mechanic_electrical.json ('One poster suggests the starter relay sits behind the passenger-side front fender liner; unverified'); catalogue listing 'Starter Relay Giulia and Stelvio' (centerlinealfa.com, SKU RS401, third-party seller).
items.notes: Location is one forum poster's suggestion and is unverified; it may well be inside a PDC. Treat the dot as 'somewhere on the front right'. The catalogue gives no Mopar part number for it.
